vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: The dashboard is signed in through the same OIDC provider, so a browser with no session must be sent to sign in first.

conops.paraphrase: A user who opens the gateway in a browser is redirected through the same Okta sign-in.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: Every signed-in person lands on their own My usage page after sign-in.

conops.paraphrase: After sign-in the user sees My Usage, and the session cookie is set.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: Members of the admin group get the admin navigation, which is the only place admins see organization usage.

conops.paraphrase: The admin signs in and the gateway recognizes the admin group, then shows My Usage.

vision.section: §9 — Design Direction
vision.paraphrase: Admin-only pages are absent from a non-admin's navigation, so non-admins see only My usage.

conops.paraphrase: A non-admin's navigation shows the My usage link only, with no admin links.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: Admins also see Usage, User detail and Cache, so their navigation carries those three links beside My usage.

conops.paraphrase: The admin's navigation shows My usage, Usage and Cache.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: Admin pages are reserved for admins, so direct visits by non-admins are refused.

conops.paraphrase: Opening an admin address directly returns a forbidden status and a Not Authorized page.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: A non-admin refused an admin page is offered a route back to their own usage.

conops.paraphrase: The Not Authorized page offers a Go to My usage link.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: A person can end the browser session from the header, and the dashboard then requires sign-in again.

conops.paraphrase: The user signs out from the header and the browser session ends.
The admin signs out from the header and sees the signed-out confirmation.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: After signing out, a person can start a new sign-in from the signed-out page.

conops.paraphrase: The signed-out page offers a Sign in link to start again.

claude_md.paraphrase: Collapsing the header controls into a sheet on narrow viewports is how the app shell stays usable at 320 CSS px without horizontal scrolling or clipped controls.

requirements.rationale: Derived from the App Shell section of docs/product-vision-planning/ux/screens.md: below 480 px the nav, email and Sign out collapse into a Sheet behind a menu trigger. It is the mechanism that keeps the header usable at the 320 px layout floor.

vision.section: §9 — Design Direction
vision.paraphrase: The dashboard must be readable in light and dark, so the person can choose a theme that persists.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: My usage shows the same figures as the my_usage tool, so the browser and Claude Code agree.

conops.paraphrase: My Usage shows spent, quota, remaining, clips, cache hits and reset, the same figures my_usage returns.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: My usage can show any calendar month, which lets a person compare past months with the current one.

conops.paraphrase: My Usage shows the figures for the month chosen in the Month select.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: The dashboard tells a person when their quota is used up and when narration resumes.

conops.paraphrase: The over-quota message names the spend, quota and reset time, as the dashboard notice does.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: A person can return the month view to the current month in one step after browsing another month.

conops.paraphrase: The Month select on My Usage can be set back to the current month.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: A person whose usage did not load can retry without leaving the page, so they still see where they stand.

vision.section: §5 — Goals & Success Criteria (MVP)
vision.paraphrase: Goal G8 requires admins to see every user's month-to-date spend on the Usage page.

conops.paraphrase: The Usage page lists one row per user for the chosen month, sorted by spend with the highest first.

vision.section: §5 — Goals & Success Criteria (MVP)
vision.paraphrase: Goal G3 requires the Usage page to flag each over-quota user, so admins see who has hit the limit.

conops.paraphrase: A user whose spend has reached their quota shows an OVER badge in the Status column.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: The Usage page gives admins an organization-wide total for the month, not only per-user rows.

conops.paraphrase: The Usage table ends with a Total footer row for the month.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: A month with no usage must be shown as empty, so an admin can tell it apart from a page that failed to load.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: When usage cannot be loaded, the Usage page says so and offers a retry, so admins are not left with a blank table.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: Admins drill from the per-user table into one user's detail, the User detail page the vision names.

conops.paraphrase: The admin clicks a user's email on the Usage table and opens that user's detail.

vision.section: §9 — Design Direction
vision.paraphrase: The dashboard shows no narration text anywhere, so the user detail lists clips without their text.

conops.paraphrase: User detail shows the user's rows for the month, never the narration text.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: The User detail page summarizes one user's month against their quota, which is the admin's per-person view.

conops.paraphrase: User detail summarizes the month's spend against quota, clips and cache-hit rate.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: User detail shows the user's current quota and whether it is the default, so an admin knows what they are changing.

conops.paraphrase: The quota field shows the current figure and notes it is the default when no override exists.

vision.section: §5 — Goals & Success Criteria (MVP)
vision.paraphrase: Goal G8 requires an admin to change one user's quota from the dashboard.

conops.paraphrase: The admin enters a new monthly quota and saves it, and the page confirms the change.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: A failed quota save is reported in text and keeps the entered amount, so the admin can retry without retyping.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: An admin can remove a user's override and return them to the default quota.

conops.paraphrase: The admin clears an override via Use default and a confirmation, and the page confirms the reset.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: User detail can show any month, so an admin can review a user's past rows.

conops.paraphrase: User detail shows the user's usage rows for the month chosen in the Month select.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: An admin can always return from a user's detail to the Usage page through a breadcrumb or a back link.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: When a user's detail cannot load, the page says so and offers a retry, so the admin is not left guessing.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: The Cache page shows size against the cap, clip count, hit rate and evictions, which tells the admin whether the cache pays off.

conops.paraphrase: The Cache page shows size against the size cap, clip count, hit rate and evictions this month.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: A cache with no clips is shown as empty, so an admin can tell an empty cache from a failed one.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: When cache statistics cannot load, the Cache page says so and offers a retry.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Usage dashboard (built last, after narration and quotas)
vision.paraphrase: The Cache page can be refreshed on demand so the admin sees current figures.

conops.paraphrase: The admin reviews current cache figures on the Cache page.
